atlas_description: Assembly + annotation lens for the F₁ hybrid (C. gariepinus × C. macrocephalus). Chromosome architecture, gene tracks, repeat / TE landscape, synteny against related Siluriformes, and variant annotations that contextualize Inversion Atlas candidates.
_cohort: F₁ hybrid (C. gariepinus × C. macrocephalus) — NOT the 226-sample hatchery cohort. See KICKOFF_genome_atlas.md.
_pages_migration_note_2026_05_19: page_crossovers + page_nco_gc moved to meiosis-atlas on 2026-05-19 (per KICKOFF_meiosis_atlas.md). Per-inversion-candidate meiosis views run on the F₁×F₁ progeny cohort, not the F₁ hybrid cohort that the rest of this atlas describes — cohort discipline requires the carve-out. page_chromosome_overview's CO-density sub-track still reads crossover_track for visualisation, now a cross-atlas read from meiosis-atlas's layers registry.

pages.label: scaffold
pages.tooltip: Genome Atlas landing / scaffold preview. Vision, required data layers, chromosome-overview mockup, panel inventory, phasing roadmap, cross-references. Layout-only; per-page renderers ship as cluster-side genome layers land (SCHEMA §28, phase A).

pages.label: assembly stats
pages.tooltip: Headline assembly QC for the F₁ hybrid: BUSCO single-copy %, contig/scaffold N50, gap rate, T2T completeness. Global tiles + per-chromosome QC table. Phase B.

pages.label: chromosome overview
pages.tooltip: Length-scaled chromosome strip with stacked density sub-tracks (gene · repeat · conserved · CO density · cohort overlay). Genome-Atlas primary phase-B deliverable. Mirrors the Inversion Atlas scrubber width.

pages.label: assembly methods
pages.tooltip: HiFi + Hi-C + ONT pipeline walkthrough. Pure documentation; no layer dependencies. Stays useful as long as the assembly paper is in review.

pages.label: genes
pages.tooltip: Gene track, density, and cargo-per-inversion views. Bridges the assembly paper to the Inversion Atlas's manuscript. Phase B–C.

pages.label: repeats / TE
pages.tooltip: TE landscape: per-class composition, per-chrom density heatmap, breakpoint enrichment per candidate (Spalax focal-vs-bg). Phase B.

pages.label: variant annotations
pages.tooltip: SnpEff / VEP impact overlay per inversion candidate. Final piece of the Genome Atlas (phase E). Depends on MODULE_CONSERVATION cluster-side outputs.

pages.label: conserved elements
pages.tooltip: UCE + phastCons regulatory-disruption overlay per candidate. Complements the gene-cargo view (page_genes) by counting regulatory hits, not coding hits. Phase C–D.

pages.label: synteny
pages.tooltip: Cactus pairwise synteny: ribbon diagram (Cgar vs Cmac and other Siluriformes) + per-chrom dotplot + macrosyntR-style Oxford grid (aggregated chrom-pair view, focal-pair selector, hover tooltips). Phase D.

pages.label: ancestral karyotype
pages.tooltip: Reconstructed Siluriformes ancestral karyotype + per-branch event annotations. Likely promoted to a Supplementary Note. Phase D.

pages.label: orthologues
pages.tooltip: Orthologue tables — focal genome vs. each non-focal. Three views: per-non-focal summary (1:1 / 1:n / m:1 / m:n / orphan counts), per-chrom breakdown for the focal genome, gene-level explorer with search. Focal genome is selectable and shares vocabulary with page_synteny's Oxford-grid focal pair. Driven by ortholog_tables; optional ortholog_pairs layer feeds the deep-dive per-pair gene rows. Phase D.

_shared_modules_doc: router_bridge listens on window for ga:navigate / ga:filter-page CustomEvents emitted by atlas pages (currently page_synteny's Oxford-grid click gestures) and forwards them to the shell router. Falls back to setting atlasState.shared.pendingPage + drilledPair + drilledChrom slots, which any receiving page consumes at mount() time. The shell should call install(atlasState) at atlas-register time; pages defensively call ensureInstalled(atlasState) too so the bridge works even without shell registration. The bridge is idempotent — repeated installs return the same handle.
_stylesheets_doc: Atlas-wide stylesheet for the Genome Atlas. Round 1 ships a minimal bundle: orange/coral accent overrides + the .ga-card section style used by the page_scaffold scaffold. Future rounds add per-page stylesheets and reference them from each page entry's `stylesheet` field.
_scope_pickers_doc: No scope pickers in round 1. When chromosome_map + gene_track layers land (phase B), add an activeChrom picker analogous to the Inversion Atlas's.
_stages_doc: Three stages chosen to match the kickoff (KICKOFF_genome_atlas.md §Q2): assembly (chromosomes, N50, BUSCO, gaps), annotation (genes, repeats, TEs), comparative (synteny, ancestral karyotype). Round 1 ships only one page in `assembly`; the other two stages are reserved for future rounds.
